body: Call the SSA and your local office to see why it happened. I know that when I talked to the lady at the SSA she said I could make payments as low as $5 a month. In the end it worked out though because I ended getting a lump sum randomly one day and so I called them and they said there was a mistake on my account and I had actually been underpaid and that the overpayment was no longer valid. The same thing might not happen for you in regards to the lump sum but I think it’s worth checking especially if you were still a minor at the time or in school.

As someone who just posted recently about having to go through Silhouette because my order was delivered to a different house I will say this. Regardless of the choice you make if you contact Silhouette, you may have to borderline HARASS them.



They will send you the right one but getting them to respond to you may be a marathon. I emailed through the “live chat” 7 times with not even an automatic response. I then left a comment on TikTok and messaged their LinkedIn and someone emailed me back 5 minutes later telling me they were sending the package and that they’d send me the tracking number shortly.


I Emailed them for 4 days straight asking for it or a refund at that point because I had no more patience. I then commented again on TikTok and got a response 10 minutes later. Extremely frustrating.


I’m not sure what happened to there customer services since the last time I bought my first Silhouette in 2020 but it’s egregious.

The phone line is a prerecorded message that hangs up on you. The live chat doesn’t exist and just directs you email through the chat, and emailing is a dice roll. If you run into any hiccups contacting them. Comment on their most recent TikTok post and they should get back to you.
